content.label: 02 — About KAT Arabia
content.headline: International standards,
content.body:
KAT Arabia General Contracting is an engineering and contracting company serving government entities, EPC contractors, industrial operators and private sector clients. We are part of KAT Group, a diversified multinational business group headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah and Al Jubail.

We combine international standards with local execution to deliver reliable, sustainable and value-driven projects, from design and engineering through construction, commissioning and maintenance.

content.label: 03 — Our Services
content.headline: Construction to commissioning,
content.intro: Eleven service lines across four groups — construction and infrastructure, industrial and energy, building systems and facilities, and engineering, equipment and workforce — delivered under one contract and one HSE system.

content.label: 04 — Industries We Serve
content.headline: The sectors driving
content.intro: KAT Arabia supports the industries driving growth in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, delivering integrated solutions across the region’s most vital sectors.

content.label: 05 — Workforce
content.headline: A dedicated international
content.caption: Skilled crews, sourced and tested in-house
content.body: Backed by KAT Group’s dedicated in-house international recruitment division, KAT Arabia provides integrated workforce solutions that enable clients to mobilize skilled professionals quickly, efficiently and confidently. Our network supports engineering, infrastructure, industrial, oil and gas, and maintenance projects by sourcing, assessing, mobilizing and managing qualified professionals.

content.label: 01 — Commitment
content.headline: Health, safety, environment,
content.body:
KAT Arabia is committed to protecting people, the environment and the assets entrusted to us. Health and safety, environmental responsibility and quality assurance are integrated into every stage of our engineering and contracting operations.

Areas of focus: health, safety and environment · quality assurance and quality control · regulatory compliance · incident prevention and risk management · workplace health and monitoring · contractor and supplier HSE management · environmental protection and sustainability · emergency preparedness and response · continuous improvement · training and competency · client and stakeholder confidence · legal and industry alignment.

data.title: General Contracting & Building Construction
data.summary: Commercial, residential, government, healthcare, education, hospitality and industrial buildings delivered by KAT Arabia in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
data.description:
KAT Arabia delivers integrated general contracting solutions across the commercial, residential, institutional, industrial, healthcare, hospitality and government sectors. Our project execution model emphasizes strict timeline adherence, cost management and consistent quality outcomes.

Building works are supported by our MEP, civil, equipment and workforce capabilities, giving clients a single point of responsibility. Our teams work to specification, quality standards and applicable building regulations in each market.

data.title: Civil Infrastructure & Heavy Engineering
data.summary: Roads, bridges, utility networks, water transmission, pipelines, marine works and structural engineering by KAT Arabia in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
data.description:
KAT Arabia delivers integrated civil engineering and heavy infrastructure solutions that support transportation networks, utilities, industrial expansion and urban development.

Our infrastructure teams are supported by modern plant and equipment and certified operators, with engineering supervision and quality control throughout each project.

data.title: Industrial Construction & Plant Services
data.summary: Construction, installation, commissioning, shutdown and maintenance services for manufacturing, petrochemical, mining, power and process facilities.
data.description:
KAT Arabia supports industrial growth through specialized engineering, construction and technical solutions for manufacturing, petrochemical, mining, power generation and industrial facilities.

We combine construction, mechanical installation, equipment and skilled workforce in one organization, enabling rapid mobilization for new construction, expansion and shutdown work.

data.title: Oil & Gas Engineering Services
data.summary: Engineering, construction, maintenance and technical support across upstream, midstream and downstream oil and gas, onshore and offshore.
data.description:
KAT Arabia provides engineering, construction, maintenance and technical support services across upstream, midstream and downstream oil and gas operations, both onshore and offshore.

All operations comply with international safety standards and local regulations, supporting reliability and operational excellence.

data.title: Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP) and Electro-Mechanical Solutions
data.summary: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, fire alarm, ELV, building automation, instrumentation, testing and commissioning by KAT Arabia.
data.description:
KAT Arabia delivers complete MEP and electro-mechanical solutions that enhance building performance, operational efficiency and sustainability, from installation through testing, commissioning and maintenance.

Mechanical, electrical and plumbing disciplines are coordinated within a single team and delivered either as part of a building project or as a standalone package.

data.title: Energy, Electrical & Solar Solutions
data.summary: Electrical installation, solar system design and implementation, power distribution and energy efficiency solutions for infrastructure and industrial projects.
data.description:
KAT Arabia delivers modern energy solutions for infrastructure and industrial projects, helping clients optimize energy usage while integrating sustainable practices into their facilities.

Our electrical and engineering teams support projects from design through installation and ongoing maintenance.

data.title: Engineering, Contracting & Project Management
data.summary: Civil, mechanical and electrical contracting, design and engineering, project management and site supervision by KAT Arabia.
data.description:
Our engineering division is equipped to handle technically demanding projects across multiple disciplines. Experienced engineers and technical supervisors ensure that every phase of a project is executed according to strict specifications, quality standards and best practice.

Our integrated project execution model combines planning, technical supervision and on-site delivery, supporting seamless execution from engineering and construction through commissioning and maintenance.

data.title: Plant & Equipment Solutions
data.summary: Cranes, excavators, loaders, forklifts, generators and material handling equipment supplied with certified operators.
data.description:
KAT Arabia provides modern construction equipment and certified operators that support productivity, safety and operational efficiency at every stage of project delivery.

Equipment is supplied with certified operators and supported by experienced professionals, and is coordinated with our construction and workforce teams.

data.title: Integrated Facility Management
data.summary: Hard and soft facility management, building, MEP and civil maintenance, asset and energy management by KAT Arabia.
data.description:
KAT Arabia delivers integrated facility management and technical maintenance solutions that preserve asset value and ensure long-term operational reliability.

Technical and operational services are delivered under one contract, with maintenance planned to protect asset performance across the full lifecycle.

data.title: Camp Construction & Maintenance
data.summary: Labor camp construction, modular camp setup, utility infrastructure and camp maintenance services by KAT Arabia.
data.description:
KAT Arabia provides complete solutions for workforce accommodation and site infrastructure. Our designs prioritize functionality, compliance, safety and comfort, supporting smooth operations for project teams.

Camp construction, utilities and ongoing maintenance are delivered by one contractor, supported by our workforce and facility management teams.

data.title: Project Workforce Solutions
data.summary: Project workforce supply, global talent acquisition, executive search, trade testing and large-scale mobilization from KAT Group's in-house recruitment division.
data.description:
Backed by KAT Group's dedicated in-house international recruitment division, KAT Arabia provides integrated workforce solutions that enable clients to mobilize skilled professionals quickly, efficiently and confidently. Our network supports engineering, infrastructure, industrial, oil and gas, and maintenance projects by sourcing, assessing, mobilizing and managing qualified professionals.

We support clients across every stage of project execution, with flexible deployment aligned to project requirements and rapid mobilization to meet project timelines.
